hero.heading: Welcome to My Bracelet Shop! 🌸
hero.body: I make every single bracelet by hand, just for you! I love picking out the prettiest beads and charms. I hope you find something you really love!
hero.title: Bracelets made just for you!
hero.subtitle: Every bracelet is handmade by me, Lily! I pick the prettiest beads and string them together with lots of care. Find your favourite colour and wear it every day.

about-maker: I make every bracelet myself — no machines!
I use colourful beads, shiny charms, and stretchy cord
Every order gets a little thank-you note from me 💌

about.heading: Hi, I'm the bracelet maker! 👋
about.body: My name is Lily and I am 10 years old. I started making bracelets because I wanted one in every colour! Now I make them for everyone. Each bracelet is made with lots of care and a little bit of glitter ✨. I hope wearing one makes you smile!
